name: Increase
overview: The Scriptures reveal that increase is a divine blessing from the LORD, manifesting in both material abundance and personal growth. Isaac’s hundredfold harvest exemplifies God’s faithful provision (Genesis 26:12), while the promise of multiplication extends to future generations (Deuteronomy 1:11; Psalms 115:14). Additionally, increase encompasses spiritual and relational dimensions, as God enlarges our steps to prevent stumbling (Psalms 18:36) and brings comfort and greatness in our lives (Psalms 71:21), assuring that even humble beginnings can lead to significant advancement (Job 8:7).
